visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler girl wearing a red t-shirt with a Mario character print stands in a brightly lit indoor living room. The room contains various household items like a bicycle wheel, a red scooter, and roller skates near a closet wall. She gestures with her arms while looking toward the camera. (2) The girl begins walking across the wooden floor towards a hallway, the camera following her from an eye-level perspective. She turns and enters a narrow hallway leading to other rooms, looking back momentarily. (3) She walks into a bedroom where a large bed with a pink safety rail is visible. The bed is covered with numerous plush toys, including characters like Stitch and Duffy. She approaches the side of the bed. (4) The toddler climbs onto the bed, navigating through the pile of stuffed animals. A woman in a white tank top is partially visible in the background, assisting her or interacting on the bed. (5) The girl finds small yellow shark toys among the plushies. A man's hand reaches into the frame to take one of the toys from her as she sits comfortably on the bed looking at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a light, cheerful acoustic guitar plucking melody at approximately 110 BPM. A toddler girl’s high-pitched, energetic voice is heard speaking in Traditional Chinese, explaining that something is not outside. A man's calm, moderate-pitched voice responds to her. (2) Soft, rhythmic thudding sounds of footsteps on wood occur as the child moves. She says 'bye-bye' clearly in a playful tone. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (3) The toddler continues her high-arousal speech, repeating farewells. Faint rustling of clothing and bedding is audible. Occasional high-pitched 'Ding' and 'Pop' sound effects are added in post-production for text emphasis. (4) Sounds of fabric movement and a wooden bunk bed creaking occur as the child climbs. She shouts excitedly about finding the object ('找到了') with a rising intonation. A second female voice briefly laughs in the background. The man's voice enters again, speaking in a low, gentle narrative tone.
